title: B-Group Vitamins
author: EJHcv6GrpmCFmfDvc
chapter_outcomes: Understand the sources and functions of proteins (high biological value and low biological value) and carbohydrates, including monosaccharides, disaccharides, and polysaccharides.
Understand the sources and functions of fats in the diet.
Understand the sources and functions of vitamins A, C, D, E, K, and the B group (thiamin, riboflavin, nicotinic acid, and cobalamin).
Understand the sources and functions of mineral elements, including calcium, iron, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, fluoride, chloride, and iodide.
Understand the sources and functions of water in the human diet.
Understand the sources and uses of food energy in the body.
Understand the sources and functions of non-starch polysaccharides (NSP), also known as dietary fibre.
